listing.summary: The project reports startup, title, menus and input using a CPU-renderer workaround. A full playthrough is unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-21451 extracted disc and ELF. The ELF must match SHA-256 0b7542e52b4bb017109f569d3a6369945a95f71a4f21d58f9d27ccc278962ce7.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s local Git Bash, Ghidra, recompilation and Visual Studio instructions using your own disc files.
